    "iree-run-requirement=runtime.resource.amd_gpu"
    "runtime-resource=amd-gpu"
    "loom-execution-profile=amdgpu_access"
    "loom-target-family=amdgpu"
    "loom-target-class=gpu"
    "loom-executor=hardware"
  RESOURCE_GROUP
    "gpu-device"
)
endif()
